rpix (development version)
text: add() now pixi_add(). add() still works now, deprecation warning. remove() search() now pixi_remove() pixi_search(). old names removed rather deprecated, masked base::remove() base::search() whenever rpix attached. pixi_to_path() removed. rpix finds pixi . setup_pixi() now sets project: creates pixi.toml needed, adds R (r_version picks version), installs rpix environment, dependencies conda-forge. add_to_rprofile global arguments gone. setup_pixi() removes “Pixi R library setup” block earlier versions added project’s .Rprofile, warns ’s one ~/.Rprofile. reset_r_libraries() removed.

title: rpix (development version)
text: pixi commands now go single internal runner built processx (#19). Arguments passed without shell quoting, commands work subfolder project (--manifest-path), pixi failures become R errors, pixi found even isn’t PATH (set options(rpix.pixi_path = ...) unusual installs). pixi_add(), pixi_remove() pixi_search() dry_run = TRUE now return command invisibly. R package names now translated conda names properly (#21): names lowercased ("Rcpp" becomes r-rcpp), pak-like prefix says package comes : "bioc::DESeq2" Bioconductor packages bioconda (#17), "conda::gdal" conda packages aren’t R packages. Names - _ used . pixi_add() accepts version constraints inline ("dplyr>=1.1") one constraint per package versions. pixi_add(channel = ) works : pixi --channel flag pixi add, channel now added project used package spec. happens automatically bioconda. pixi_add() suggests bioc:: conda:: package can’t found. Added tests.
